description: Defines the ImageProcessorBackend class and related structures for GPU image processing in ChromeOS, including configuration, callbacks, and processing methods.

classes.name: ImageProcessorBackend
classes.description: Abstract class for GPU image processing backend, managing configuration, processing, and error handling.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes input frame into output frame in IMPORT mode, invoking callback upon completion.

methods.name: ProcessLegacy
methods.description: Processes frame into an allocated output buffer in ALLOCATE mode, optional if not supported.

methods.name: output_mode
methods.description: Returns the current output mode (ALLOCATE or IMPORT).

methods.name: needs_linear_output_buffers
methods.description: Indicates if linear output buffers are needed.

methods.name: supports_incoherent_buffers
methods.description: Indicates if incoherent buffers are supported.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the backend as a string.
